description: This file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates the use of DialogFragments to display dialogs in a stack, allowing for multiple overlay dialogs with different styles. It includes inner classes for fragment dialogs and manages fragment transactions and dialog styling.

classes.name: FragmentDialog
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating dialog stack management with DialogFragment.

classes.name: MyDialogFragment
classes.description: Inner static class extending DialogFragment, responsible for displaying individual dialogs with styles based on input argument.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing the activity, setting layout, initializing UI components, and restoring state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current dialog stack level to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a new dialog fragment, managing the fragment transaction and dialog stacking.

methods.name: getNameForNum
methods.description: Utility method returning string description for dialog style based on a number.
